report.summary: Sourcing is strong overall: 86 tag instances were checked and the vast majority are supported, with every embedded year, figure, name, date and percentage matching the cited page's excerpts (the segment list, customer names, tender chain, offer size, ₹1,130 lakhs working-capital object, both balance-sheet and P&L series, promoter shareholding and related-party figures all verify). Only two soft spots surfaced: tag 75 on p12 is partial because the 'losing Indian Railways would result in a significant dip in revenues' clause is not present in the p12 excerpt (the 57% concentration itself is verbatim), and one untagged sentence states derived EBITDA margins (15% FY2018 / 10% FY2015), which is exempt writer's arithmetic on already-cited figures. No unsupported or wrong-source tags and no blocking untagged number/date/name/segment claims, so blocking_count is zero.

untagged_claims.sentence: On the disclosed figures, EBITDA margin in FY2018 works out to roughly 15% of revenue against roughly 10% in FY2015 — the writer's arithmetic on the filing's numbers, not a filing disclosure.
untagged_claims.suggestion: exempt — derived arithmetic (9.29/60.53 and 9.46/90.21) on already-cited p27/p111 figures; the report itself labels it as the writer's arithmetic, so no separate source needed.
